blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Kapatid, a support group for political prisoners, called out the “double standards” in the country’s prison system after it was learned that former Speaker Martin Romualdez has a personal aide while in detention. “The flood-control scandal has exposed the staggering scale of corruption and abuse of public trust. It also underscores another longstanding injustice: double standards in a prison system where privilege can mean better treatment while ordinary persons deprived of liberty (PDLs) struggle for their most basic rights,” Kapatid spokesperson Fides Lim said in a statement on Tuesday.
